name: Lo camin de l'escòla
source:
Adishatz! Hello!

You arrive in a high school in Béarn, in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques, and do not know the language. How are you going to do it ? We will have to learn the Bearnais, and your friends will help you!

[From [url=https://khan-art-studio.itch.io/lo-camin-de-lescla]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿迪沙兹！你好！

你到达大西洋比利牛斯山脉贝亚恩的一所高中，但不懂当地语言。你打算怎么做？我们必须学习贝阿奈语，你的朋友会帮助你的！

[来自[url=https://khan-art-studio.itch.io/lo-camin-de-lescla]itch.io[/url]]
